In today's episode; Dr. Josh Helman, the Medical Director at Hippocrates Wellness. Discover the innovative approaches that challenge conventional beliefs about incurable diseases and provide hope for patients around the world.

Dr. Helman shares personal stories and experiences that shaped his journey in tackling this critical health issue, emphasizing the importance of lifestyle changes such as diet, exercise, stress reduction, and sleep quality. Explore how reconnecting with natural, ancestral eating habits and improving overall wellness can lead to cognitive revitalization. This episode sheds light on the promising future of Alzheimer's treatment, encouraging listeners to take proactive steps in their own health journeys.
